message: ちっちゃなボディーガード

name: Synn
message: 「Gyo-gyo!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Good morning」

name: Nanaka
message: 「G-Good morning~」

name: Synn
message: 「Wawah!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「She was fine until just a moment ago, but it seems she struggled with waking up earlier than she is used to」
Even so, falling asleep standing up...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Morning, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good morning~」

name: Synn
message: 「So, why are you here?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Already taming this angel, huh? Impressive as always」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Truth be told, I was so anxious about the agenda that I simply couldn't sit still」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, she doesn't trust you at all, huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. I believed that the President would pull it off」
Gulp. Truth is, I barely made it in time--that was close~.

name: Lolotte
message: 「What I am worried about is: 'Can he actually bring the important documents safely all the way to school?'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How dramatic」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Like tripping on the way and dropping them in a gutter, leaving them on the train's overhead rack, or accidentally using them instead of tissues」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on. I'm not that much of a clumsy girl」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're a guy in the first place!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Perhaps someone like a little devil might even target them」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for worrying about me. But--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is why I shall protect you, Mr. President, all the way to the Student Council room!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What one would call an escort--a bodyguard, yes」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I get that part, but...」
I could never bring myself to say that she's the one I'm most worried about.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, let us be off」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady. What shall we do about the car?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I will do my best on my own. I shall walk to school today」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on a second!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is something the matter?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn. A chance like this doesn't come around often」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't you wanna ride in that luxury car?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I mean, if I actually could, I'd love to try it, sure」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then it's settled!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Lolo-chan. Since we're all going anyway, would it be... too much to ask if we could catch a ride with you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, Jeeves... what do you think?」

name: Riesling
message: 「I have no objections whatsoever」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let us do that. Please, go right ahead and get in」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Woohoo!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, what about your bodyguard duty then, Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Leave it to me! I shall protect you from any outside threats, even if I must use my own body as a shield」
Am I being targeted by some silent sniper or something?
Wait, could this actually be one of the perks of becoming Student Council President!?

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, I'll take you up on that offer」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hehe, please leave the safe driving to me, Riesling Tooyama」
With that smile so uncharacteristic of her, I should have realized something important...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aaaah, that was fun!」
A high-speed drive reminiscent of a movie car chase.
Honestly, I thought her handling--tearing through narrow public roads with barely an inch to spare--was amazing.

name: Synn
message: 「B-But... still... uuugh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Seriously, how pathetic can you get? And after you got to enjoy the ride of a luxury car, too!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so... So this is a luxury car, huh... Guess it's still too much for me...」
Dizzy as I am, I'm carrying Lolotte on my back through sheer willpower.

name: Riesling
message: 「For today's sake, she stayed up desperately studying self-defense last night」
While Nanaka had been headbanging along in high spirits, Lolotte was fast asleep right beside me.
Her sweet-smelling, silky hair was right there, and Lolotte's soft cheek was resting on my shoulder...
It really wasn't that far of a distance, yet during that car ride I experienced both heaven and hell.

name: Synn
message: 「Good grief... She didn't even need to do all that」
Lolotte breathing softly in her sleep, having completely forgotten about acting as a bodyguard, is truly endearing.

name: Riesling
message: 「My apologies, but I leave the young lady in your care」

name: Synn
message: 「No, not at all. Well then, first let's head to the Student Council room--」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hyaaah!?」

name: Synn
message: 「The notebook with the agenda notes... I left it at home」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You really are... officially a klutz!」
Riesling-san grins wickedly. And so, I ended up experiencing that thrill two more times.
